notes:
أقرب mapping للـquery هو:

department name + phone → SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT
الطلاب + FULL_NAME → MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY
الربط يكون عبر اسم القسم، باستخدام SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME مع MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT_NAME.
عدد الطلاب → COUNT(*)
أطول اسم كامل → MAX(LENGTH(FULL_NAME))
question_text: For each department, list the department name, department phone number, number of students, and the length of the longest student full name in that department.
